# Effect: reverb

Reverb: simulates the space and tail of a room or hall.

**Where to put it**: Put it at the end of the chain on melody, pad and vocal tracks; use little or none on bass and kick, or the low end gets muddy.

Latest parameters: `muser effects reverb` (MCP: `describe_effect`)

## Parameters

| Parameter | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mix` | 0.25 | 0 – 1 | Dry/wet mix. 0.1-0.2 slight space; 0.25-0.35 normal; >0.5 very wet, sound moves far away |
| `decay_seconds` | 1.6 | 0.05 – 120 s | Tail decay time. 0.3-0.8 small room; 1.2-2.5 hall; >4 ambient |
| `damping` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | High-frequency damping. Higher = darker, warmer tail; lower = brighter, more metallic |
| `size` | 0.5 | 0 – 1 | Space size. 0.2 small room; 0.5 medium; 0.8+ hall/cathedral |

All parameters can be omitted and take their default when omitted; when a value is out of range, `muser validate` reports the exact location.

## Minimal example

```json
{ "type": "reverb", "mix": 0.3, "decay_seconds": 2.2, "size": 0.7 }
```

## Scenario presets

- Small room (makes drums and acoustic instruments sound real)

  ```json
  {"type": "reverb", "mix": 0.15, "decay_seconds": 0.6, "damping": 0.5, "size": 0.25}
  ```

- Regular hall (pad, strings, vocals)

  ```json
  {"type": "reverb", "mix": 0.3, "decay_seconds": 2.0, "damping": 0.5, "size": 0.6}
  ```

- Ambient long tail (ambient, lo-fi keys)

  ```json
  {"type": "reverb", "mix": 0.45, "decay_seconds": 5.0, "damping": 0.6, "size": 0.9}
  ```

- Bright metallic (glockenspiel, synth pluck)

  ```json
  {"type": "reverb", "mix": 0.25, "decay_seconds": 1.8, "damping": 0.15, "size": 0.6}
  ```

## Tips and common mistakes

- When several tracks all need a sense of space, give each track a small mix (0.1-0.2); this is more natural than one track with a large mix.
- Avoid it on bass and kick; if you must, keep mix <= 0.1 and put an `eq` highpass at 150Hz in front of it.
- Put the reverb at the end of the chain (after delay); placing it before the compressor makes the tail get compressed and sound unnatural.
- The tail continues past the end of the project, so when rendering `--tail` must be longer than decay_seconds, or it will be cut off.
